initial_unsettled_lifecycle.failure: cache recreation or font memory cleanup failed on the third font run
initial_unsettled_lifecycle.interpretation: The memory sample coincided with Tailscale boot completion. Startup allocations were still changing; attribution to a cache leak was not established. The passing rerun preserved IME contention and the 32 KiB limit, then waited 60 seconds on the same serial connection before the memory baseline.

limitations: Private serial transcripts may contain network identity; only hashes are published.
Quiet native counters cover one CRC. Loaded counters cover two CRCs plus font/Write for uniform trials, and one CRC plus font/Write for the burst trial.
Both firmware configurations and instrumentation are identical except the asset sector set calculation; later lifecycle harness changes do not change the firmware.
CRC timings include checksum CPU work, copying and voluntary scheduling; this is not maximum raw SD throughput.
Two quiet samples per paired firmware and one uniform setting per rate do not establish latency distributions. The faster run sends fewer packets; actual counts are retained.
Peak Wi-Fi wait did not improve. Write p95 increased at 25 pps and decreased slightly at 100 pps; shared-lock and scheduling tails remain separate work.
No native writes were observed in the measurement windows; write throughput, power loss, boot speed and other cards are not qualified.
